Standard: Means of activating or utilizing the pre-crash warning system are accessible for immediate use from each crew station in the cockpit without crewmembers leaving their seated position. Method of Compliance: Prior to entering operational test or operations, verify the standard by the following method(s): Examination.
(1) Review engineering drawings or digital models to verify that controls to activate the pre-crash warning system are located at each crew station in the cockpit in a position so that the intended anthropometric range of crew members can activate the system from a seated position.
(2) Examine the air vehicle and verify that controls to activate the pre-crash warning system are located at each crew station in the cockpit in a position so that the intended anthropometric range of crew members can activate the system from a seated position.
